rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutionally framed: the trigger-centric text does not clearly cover bump stocks, and criminal-law separation-of-powers/notice concerns prevent ATF from expanding liability by reversal. Thomas or Gorsuch are the most likely concurrence writers to press a stronger lenity/nondeference-to-agencies-in-criminal-law rationale, with Sotomayor likely to dissent on a volitional/ordinary-meaning reading of "automatically" and "single function."
